entities.summary: Ruperto Nicolás Herrera Tabio is a former basketball player from Cuba. At a height of 2.00 m tall, and a weight of 95 kg (210 lbs.), he played at the shooting guard and small forward positions. He received the FIBA Order of Merit in 1999, and he became a FIBA Hall of Fame player, in 2015. He was awarded with the Olympic Order, in 2019. Ruperto Herrera Tabio was a athletes & competitors from Havana (b. 1949-12-06, Havana). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
